# Benchmark Email
> Powerfully simple email marketing software for small businesses. Build, send, and track email campaigns — send your first campaign free in under 15 minutes.
Benchmark Email helps small businesses and marketers grow with easy drag-and-drop email design, list building and segmentation, automation, and reporting. This file points AI agents to our most important pages first, followed by supporting resources.

 Email Questions? We've Got you. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Why should I choose Benchmark Email?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
Unlike most email platforms that have turned into bloated marketing suites, we've stripped email marketing down to what actually matters. You're busy and just need to get emails out the door. We're simple and here to help if you hit a snag.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I build an email with no design experience?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
Definitely. Our email marketing platform includes a drag-and-drop email builder, professionally designed email templates, and pre-built layouts making Benchmark ideal for beginners and pros alike.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Is Benchmark Email ideal for small businesses?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
You betcha. Its user-friendly interface, drag-and-drop tools, and pre-built templates make it easy for small businesses to send newsletters, promotions, and updates. No email marketing expertise is required.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I track my email campaign performance?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
Absolutely. Our reporting is designed to surface the core insights you need to improve your email marketing results over time. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Will my emails get delivered to the inbox?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
Yes, and you won't have to stress about it. Our sending infrastructure is built to get your marketing emails to inboxes, not spam folders. We handle the technical heavy lifting so you can focus on your message, not deliverability headaches. Plus, if you ever have questions, you'll get support from real people (not bots) who actually want to help you succeed.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I try it for free and upgrade later if I like it?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
Of course. Our free plan includes 500 contacts and up to 2,500 email sends per month. All of our features are include in our free plan, so there’s no surprises when you upgrade as your subscriber list and email volume grows.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What if I have an issue?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
We’d love to help! We don’t hide our support behind exclusive plans or unruly chatbots. Whether you're sending your first email newsletter or your thousandth promotional campaign, we're ready to answer questions, troubleshoot issues, or help you get better results. 
Reach out to us >
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Still have questions? 
 
Get in touch with our support team-we're just a message away.

 Custom Fields  
 
Collect exactly what you need. Pull in standard fields like first name and email, or any custom field you can dream up to enrich your subscriber data.

Choose which list new subscribers get added to the moment they submit your form.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Automatic Contact Tagging 
 
Tag new subscribers on sign-up so they're segmented and ready to receive the right emails from day one.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Universal Embed Code 
 
Copy your embed code, drop it on your website, and you're done. Works with WordPress, Shopify, Wix, and any platform that accepts HTML.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Built-In Fraud Protection 
 
Google reCAPTCHA runs on every form automatically. No bots, no fake signups, no configuration needed.

 FAQs 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
What happens if I exceed the contact limit?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
No panic necessary. If you go over your contact limit, we’ll notify you and give you the option to upgrade your plan so you can keep sending without interruption. We won’t auto-upgrade or surprise you. You’re in control, always.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I upgrade at anytime?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
Absolutely. Whether you’re growing fast or just need more firepower, you can upgrade your plan at any time right from your account settings. Need to do more with less? Downgrading is easy. Manage your plan and usage is totally in your hands.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Do I get all features in the free plan?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
Yes! Free users get access to all features...no watered-down version here. The only limits? You can add up to 500 contacts, and you won’t be able to invite additional users to your account. It’s a great way to explore everything Benchmark Email can do, without opening your wallet.
 
 
 
 
 
 
How are additional users billed?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
All plans include 1 user. On paid plans, expanding your team is a breeze. We bill $15 per month a la carte for each additional user, no plan upgrade required. You’ll know exactly what the cost is before anything changes, so there are no surprises. 
Just a heads-up:
 if you're on the free plan, you’ll need to move to a paid plan before you can invite teammates.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What is the send limit?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
Send limits are set to keep your sender reputation safe! 
Free plans can send up to 5 times their contact limit each month, for a maximum of 2,500 emails per month.
Paid plans can send up to 10 times the contact limit of their plan each month.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Can I change my billing frequency?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
Absolutely. You can switch from monthly to annual billing. As your needs change, you can also upgrade or downgrade your plan to find the option that works best for your business.
 
 
 
 
 
 
What methods of payment do you accept?
 
Expand
 
 
 
 
We like to keep things simple—and flexible. Here’s how you can pay for your Benchmark Email plan:
Cards
We accept all of the most popular plastic: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Diners Club, JCB, and China UnionPay payments from customers worldwide.
Digital Wallets
Prefer to tap and go? We’ve got you covered with Alipay, Amazon Pay, Apple Pay, Cash App Pay, Google Pay.
Stripe Link
Already use Stripe for other purchases? Great! Just breeze through checkout using Stripe Link, no extra steps needed.
